summary: `task attach` and `task attachments` emit a JSON dry-run preview on stdout carrying dry_run:true and a non-empty `action` (the command name) plus method/url; the request preview stays on stderr.
reason: Under --dry-run --json, `task attachments` printed nothing (then only {"dry_run": true}), which agents and live dogfood's dry-run contract reject (`invalid JSON`, then `empty dry-run action`).
validated_outcome: TestTaskAttachmentsDryRunJSON asserts dry_run, action, method and url; no request is sent.
